summary: BBVA filed a routine 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases under the first tranche of its previously announced buyback program, approved by the board on July 29, 2026. Between September 7 and 11, 2026, HSBC Continental Europe, acting as first-tranche manager, executed purchases totaling EUR 712,207,062.69 to date, roughly 71.22% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. No price per share, premium, or closing condition is stated. The program is an ordinary capital-return mechanic; watch tranche completion pace, remaining authorization, and any acceleration or suspension signals.
